title: open-slide
brief: "The slide framework built for agents" — describe a deck in natural language and your coding agent writes the React; open-slide provides the 1920×1080 canvas, hot reload, a present mode with speaker notes, an in-browser click-to-comment inspector, asset management with svgl logo search, and export to static HTML, PDF and PPTX. Ships agent skills (`/create-slide`, `/slide-authoring`) for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; open-source (MIT), 8.8k stars. thelaggingway shared it untried, so treat the agent-authoring claims as unevaluated.
